Only public ADS bibliographic metadata is retained. CTAS does not download, mirror, or assert reuse rights for article full text; publisher and repository links retain their own access and reuse terms. Event association requires an exact retained transient name.

ASAS-SN describes Sky Patrol light curves as public and provides publication citations. CTAS may link an operator to the official HTTPS coordinate-query page. Only observation and product rows explicitly marked PUBLIC are retained. Product bytes remain provider-hosted; this system stores metadata and official download links only.
NED host queries require one unambiguous host identity; transient coordinates are not silently substituted.

The anonymous public NED TAP service documents programmatic cone searches of the NED Object Directory and requests NED acknowledgment. CTAS retains bounded source-native rows and provenance only. NOIRLab's provider-owned API authentication notebook states that anyone may retrieve public files while proprietary-file retrieval requires authorization. This adapter sends no credential and retains a product only after an exact file-metadata lookup supplies a nonblank release_date no later than the query time. Anonymous metadata about unreleased files is counted only for exclusion and is never stored. Product bytes are not downloaded.
